conclusion: Existing saved banks can support a descriptive target-sign smoothness comparison only for the first_order_utility_live trajectory: all 10 pairs and 16 episodes. They cannot support the analogous six-arm/live raw-response comparison or identify actual canonical-logit changes or susceptibility. SUMMARY.json alone is insufficient. No values, graph, signs or energies have been computed here.

saved_schema.available: Each episodes[e] retains utility_raw_costs[p] and observed_finite_response_costs[p], detached [n_pair,4] tensors, alongside pair counts, Q and scalar diagnostics. The exact reader validates both banks. Utility values are first-order private-gradient loss-change costs; finite values are paid softplus target-margin loss changes at the same utility state.
saved_schema.unavailable: Ordinary live/uniform/margins/graph_free/permuted/stop_q info retains assignments and scalar pair metrics. Its raw_costs, before/after margins and native logits are ephemeral and omitted from persisted history. The initial warm response similarly saves scalar metrics/Q, not a 16-episode raw cost bank. Do not reconstruct spatial response fields from Q, RMS, loss scalars or endpoint parameters.
saved_schema.state: Persisted episode info comes from the fresh theta-plus response starting from the episode's ORIGINAL private rows, after the core step. Probe costs concern a discarded private probe, not the committed main private update or served endpoint-logit change.
saved_schema.population: Exactly 160 pair/episode cells, episodes 1..16, lexicographic (0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(0,4),(1,2),(1,3),(1,4),(2,3),(2,4),(3,4); M=4. S=2449, class counts [631,906,578,231,103], total pair memberships=9796=4S.
saved_schema.row_join: Original S IDs are increasing node-ID order. For pair (a,b), row i is the i-th increasing S index whose label is a or b (torch.nonzero's increasing index order); labels are interleaved, not left-class-then-right-class blocks. Columns follow the fixed private-member tuple order 0..3. No node IDs or target-label sequence is persisted with the cost banks: a future exact join needs the pinned original roles and permitted copied S labels; counts alone cannot supply signs.

theory.signs: For a<b define canonical contrast d_im=z_im,a-z_im,b and permitted t_i=+1 for target a, -1 for target b; J=diag(t). _margin is ell_im=softplus(-t_i*d_im). Global reversal of all signs does not change either quadratic.
theory.finite_proxy: F_im=ell_im(after probe)-ell_im(before). Exactly, t_i*F_im=-a_bar_im*Delta_d_im, where a_bar_im=integral_0^1 sigmoid[-t_i*(d_im+u*Delta_d_im)]du. Thus signed finite loss response is susceptibility-weighted canonical contrast change, not Delta_d itself.
theory.first_order_proxy: U_im=-eta_probe*<grad_phi ell_im,g_m>, with g_m=grad_phi mean-S CE. If Delta_d_FO is the canonical contrast directional change along -eta_probe*g_m, then t_i*U_im=-sigmoid(-t_i*d_im)*Delta_d_FO_im. F and U are paired on the same utility state, but neither identifies canonical response without baseline logits/susceptibility.
theory.missing_identification: Baseline/after probe logits, baseline softplus margins, per-row/member sigmoid factors and the canonical directional derivatives are not in these persisted banks. F and U alone cannot undo their unknown nonlinear/directional susceptibility weights. Member centering also does not remove a member-varying susceptibility factor.
theory.gauge_identity: For any fixed symmetric nonnegative W with zero diagonal and L=diag(W1)-W: G0(Y)=tr(Y^T L Y)=sum_{i<j}w_ij||Y_i-Y_j||^2; Gt(Y)=tr((JY)^T L(JY))=sum_{i<j}w_ij||t_iY_i-t_jY_j||^2. Gt-G0=4*sum_{cross-target i<j}w_ij<Y_i,Y_j>. Same-target edges contribute identically. Lower signed energy therefore measures anticorrelation across opposite-target edges of this proxy field; it does not demonstrate smoother true logit changes or better responsibilities.
theory.constraints: The actual solver projects every gradient onto the row/column mass tangent. For a fixed normalized cost, row constants and constant member-column offsets do not drive that tangent. Comparing JX without removing a global member offset can create a sign effect that has no allocation-cost counterpart. This is a required diagnostic confound check, not a change to the solver.
theory.current_topology_limit: Target signs preserve graph support, components and isolates. The actual induced pair supports have 58.82%-82.34% isolates; full public G is connected. Census supports fragmentation only. It supplies no response covariance, signs/fields, reduced-L spectrum or proof that a fixed two-hop terminal graph is connected. The retained connected-graph class-imbalance curvature proposition does not apply to the disconnected current induced K and is not an empirical orientation warrant.

fixed_comparison.graph: Primary L is the unchanged protocol pair graph: exact native undirected nonloop K restricted to S_pair, W=K/(1+max row_sum(K)), L=diag(W1)-W. Use the identical W, vertex order and denominator for unsigned and signed fields. A public-path/two-hop L may replace this only as a separately frozen/source-reviewed prospective graph; do not choose hop counts, weights or graph variants using these energy values.
fixed_comparison.centering: For each cell and raw bank D in {F,U}, X_D=D-(row mean across the four members). Requested source-exact comparison uses Y_D=X_D. The allocation-relevant comparison uses Y_D=X_D-(column mean across all n_pair rows)=P_n D P_M. Apply J AFTER this projection and do not re-center JY across nodes.
fixed_comparison.shared_scale: Use one fixed finite-response reference scale s_F^2=0.001^2+||X_F||_F^2/(n_pair*M). The same s_F is used for F/U, unsigned/signed, and source-exact/allocation-projected readouts in this cell. This is a declared diagnostic reference; utility's actual assignment normalizer uses its own U RMS and is not relabeled. Record raw norms/scales as well.
fixed_comparison.shared_denominators: Record raw G0 and Gt (quadratic without the objective's gamma/2 factor), and node/member-normalized E0=G0/(n_pair*M*s_F^2), Et=Gt/(n_pair*M*s_F^2). Also record per-edge-weight values G/(M*s_F^2*omega), omega=sum_{i<j}w_ij, for both signs using exactly the same omega; this exposes dilution by isolate coverage. If omega=0, edge-normalized values are undefined, while both raw graph energies are zero. No diagonal loops enter omega.
fixed_comparison.contrast: Retain Et-E0 and (Et-E0)/(Et+E0), with the latter undefined when its denominator is zero. J is norm-preserving, so no sign-specific RMS, degree normalization, class reweighting, mean removal, susceptibility division or selected threshold is permitted.
fixed_comparison.retain: Keep every cell for both available F/U banks and both declared centering readouts, including zeros and undefined ratios. Report exact class/node/edge denominators, finite-field norm, same/cross-target edge masses and graph coverage. Full per-pair 16-episode series and one equal-cell mean/range use all 160 cells; pair memberships/edges and consecutive episodes overlap, so no independence test or unique-node interpretation follows.
fixed_comparison.future_admission_only: This spec grants no data access. A future minimal existing-reader extension would need immutable exact bank custody, all16/all10 [n_pair,4] checks, genuine original S row/sign join and fixed graph checks. Permitted S signs use only S targets; a full joint-B custodian decode must be disclosed/authorized if used. A/VALID/TEST labels, R-label analysis, features/masks, model forwards/checkpoints/predictions and new fits remain outside scope.

assessment.sufficient_for: A paired descriptive statement about whether this utility trajectory's target-specific cost proxy aligns more closely with unsigned or signed graph smoothness, and whether that sign effect survives the known member-column offset confound.
assessment.insufficient_for: Choosing target orientation for the completed live arm; establishing canonical-logit/susceptibility smoothness, optimized-Q equivalence, gradient attribution, served quality, causal gain, superiority, capacity novelty or a new experimental gate.
assessment.decision_use: Consistent lower signed energy for the finite proxy across the retained series, supported rather than created by the mass-projected check and paired utility proxy, can motivate a prospective mechanism question. Mixed/unsigned-favoring or zero-signal results weaken that proxy motivation. No result alone warrants changing the prior, fitting another variant or opening held labels; root assesses need without a tuned threshold.
